entities.name: AIServicesLayer
observations: 2026-05-28: Core AI lib at src/lib/ai.ts, Gemini integration at src/lib/gemini.ts
2026-05-28: API routes under src/app/api/ai/
2026-05-28: AI chat component at src/components/ai-chat.tsx
2026-05-28: Used by multiple domains — not a standalone domain, a cross-cutting service layer

[2026-06-21] Fragmentation diagnosed: TWO parallel AI abstractions exist. lib/ai.ts (typed AIProvider='ollama'|'gemini', Ollama-first with Gemini fallback, streaming chat + aiGenerateJSON<T>) has 4 consumers: cdm/synonyms, cdm/decompose, job-parse, resume-parse. lib/gemini.ts (callGemini + intra-Gemini model-chain fallback gemini-2.0-flash-lite → gemini-1.5-flash on 429) has 9 consumers: worker-rights, google-news, google-scholar, employment-report/upload, learning/generate, interview-prep, skill-graph/scaffold/refresh, skill-graph/auto-evidence, skill-graph/ingest. /api/ai/chat already gated by getUserId(). /api/ai/models hardcodes ['gemini-2.0-flash','gemini-2.5-flash','gemini-2.5-pro'].

[2026-06-21] ADR-0044 Proposed: AI provider router with Scope B (consolidation + Gemini 2.5 Pro premium tier + stub cost-guard hooks). Decisions locked: Q1=B (scope), Q2=task-class routing not model-name, Q3=stub cost-guard (surface userId + onUsage hooks but no enforcement until multi-tenancy lands), Q4=Gemini 2.5 Pro reusing existing GEMINI_API_KEY with plug-in surface kept open for Anthropic/OpenAI/local-models. Task vocabulary locked at 5 classes: chat, extract, ground, reason, summarize. Routing rule for reason task: gemini-pro ONLY (no fast-tier fallback — defeats the point of premium routing). Routing rule for ground task: gemini-fast ONLY (Ollama cannot do Google search grounding).

[2026-06-21] Three-layer architecture committed in ADR-0044: L1 Provider Router (this ADR — week of 2026-06-21), L2 Skill Registry (future ADR — re-entry trigger: auth + multi-tenancy + 3 skill-shaped features in code), L3 Tool Surface speaking MCP wire protocol (future ADR — re-entry trigger: Skill Registry shipped + one concrete tool use case like Excalidraw chat-side diagrams). Dependency direction is strict: L3 ⇒ L2 ⇒ L1. Upper layers cannot be built cleanly before L1. Slice manifest deliberately NOT written per ADR-0038 §G1 'UI-surface granularity' — AI provider is backend infrastructure not a UI surface; knowledge lives in this entity.

[2026-06-21] ADR-0021 tension acknowledged: ADR-0021 deferred all concrete AI provider work to Play Store push phase and named ADR-0022 as the push-phase deliverable. ADR-0044 ships Scope B web-side consolidation ahead of the Play push (justification: 13 fragmented callers + downstream blockers Grill Me/pgvector RAG/resume suggestions outweigh further deferral) but preserves Scope C (FirebaseAIProvider + AICoreProvider + BYOK family) as Forward Path §1 honoring the spirit of ADR-0021's deferral. Future readers must NOT interpret ADR-0044 as a license to ship mobile providers early.

[2026-06-21] Migration plan (5 days): Day 1 = this ADR + memory + change-log. Day 2 = move lib/ai.ts contents into src/lib/ai/ directory with per-provider files; old lib/ai.ts and lib/gemini.ts become deprecated re-export shims. Day 3 = migrate the 9 direct-Gemini callers in two batches (skill-graph trio + news + scholar; then worker-rights + employment-report + learning + interview-prep). Day 4 = add GeminiProProvider + per-route reason task class adoption + onUsage parsing. Day 5 = tests + browser smoke + delete deprecated shims + ADR promoted to Accepted + handoff.

[2026-06-21] ADR-0044 graduated from Proposed to Accepted. 5-day sprint delivered: Day 2 (commit 40e2c78) consolidated src/lib/ai/ as router + per-provider files; Day 3 (commit d97ceb2) migrated 14 callers to the ai.generate() façade, introduced AIProviderError cross-provider error envelope, and DELETED the legacy src/lib/ai.ts + src/lib/gemini.ts shims (no more deprecated re-exports); Day 4 (commit 24073cf) added GeminiProProvider for the 'reason' task class and wired onUsage callback end-to-end with promptTokens/completionTokens parsed across ollama + gemini-fast + gemini-pro; Day 5 (commits e5fcbe0 + 1472f75 + 18c0fbb) hardened the fallback chain, shipped smoke test infra, and promoted the ADR.

[2026-06-21] Trap: NEVER reintroduce gemini-1.5-flash or gemini-1.5-pro to any model chain — Google decommissioned the entire 1.5 lineup; both return 404 NOT_FOUND on v1beta generateContent as of 2026-06-21. Day 5 live smoke caught this when primary models 429d and the chain fell through to a dead fallback. Current chains: gemini-fast = [primary, gemini-2.0-flash-lite, gemini-2.0-flash] (modelChain deduped); gemini-pro = [primary] only by design (no in-tier fallback — degrading a reasoning task to a fast-tier model is worse than surfacing the quota error). modelOverride parameter still bypasses both chains.

[2026-06-21] Test architecture established: src/lib/ai/smoke.test.ts (6 hermetic cases, always runs) verifies router contract via fetch stubs through public ai.generate() façade. src/lib/ai/smoke.live.test.ts (5 cases, env-gated by RUN_LIVE_SMOKE_AI=1) exercises real network and accepts EITHER happy-path OR AIProviderError with status===503||429 as green (proves contract works even when quota exhausted). Runner: scripts/smoke-ai-live.ps1 loads .env with quote-stripping, forces OLLAMA_MODEL=gemma4:26b. Diagnostic: scripts/probe-gemini.ps1 hits ListModels-equivalent on arbitrary model names. Lab evidence at acceptance: 860/860 hermetic green; 5/5 live green (1 real happy-path: summarize via ollama gemma4:26b returned text + token counts {p:51, c:534}; 4 accepted error-path 429s from Gemini free-tier quota exhaustion).

[2026-06-21] Parked follow-ups (not blocking acceptance): (a) geminiErrorMessage() in gemini-fast.ts returns generic 'AI extraction failed' for non-429 responses, swallowing the underlying error body — diagnostics suffer when the real cause is something other than quota; (b) Free-tier Gemini quota is limit:0 across all models on the dev account as of 2026-06-15+, so any production-bound install must either enable Gemini billing OR rely entirely on the ollama tier. Both notes also live in /memories/repo/parked-ideas.md and user memory.

[2026-06-21] ADR-0045 Accepted: AI provenance UI + chat mode picker shipped on top of ADR-0044's router. The router data layer (ai.generate returning {json, provider, model, usage}) was already complete; this sprint added the transport envelope + UI surfaces.

[2026-06-21] Envelope contract locked in src/lib/ai/envelope.ts: { data: T, _ai: AIMeta } where AIMeta = {provider, model, usage?, durationMs}. Helpers: toAIEnvelope(body, aiResult, durationMs) for server-side wrap; unwrapAIEnvelope<T>(value) returns {data: T | undefined, ai: AIMeta | undefined} gracefully (bare values pass through with ai: undefined). isAIEnvelope(v) is a structural guard with no runtime imports. 13 hermetic tests pin the round-trip in envelope.test.ts. Graceful unwrap is deliberate forward-safety, NOT a feature-toggle — every AI route now wraps so the bare path is dead code in this codebase but lets the helpers stay reusable.

[2026-06-21] Conditional envelope pattern for routes with cache-hit or early-return branches (CDM synonyms/decompose, learning/generate, employment-report/upload, skill-graph trio): return NextResponse.json(aiResult ? toAIEnvelope(body, aiResult, aiDurationMs) : body). The bare-body path on cache hits is intentional — cached responses have no fresh AI provenance to attach. The unwrap helper handles both shapes transparently.

[2026-06-21] All 14 AI routes wrapped: job-parse, worker-rights, google-news, google-scholar, resume-parse, cdm/synonyms, cdm/decompose (Batch A, commit 21c422e); interview-prep, learning/generate, employment-report/upload, skill-graph/ingest, skill-graph/auto-evidence, skill-graph/scaffold/refresh (Batch B, commit 90d615c); plus /api/ai/chat which now accepts a task parameter validated against {chat, ground, reason, summarize} and falls back to 'chat' on unknown values (Day 3, commit 7590d6d).

[2026-06-21] AIProvenanceChip placement convention: render on the consumer surface near the AI-generated content header (results count, section title, dialog header). Component is in src/components/ai-provenance-chip.tsx; returns null when ai is null/undefined so wiring it before backfill is safe. Variants: 'inline' (default, dense) and 'footer' (with `via` prefix). Chip renders provider:model · {totalTokens}t · {durationMs}ms.

[2026-06-21] useAIQuery / useAIMutation hooks exist in src/lib/hooks/use-ai-query.ts but were intentionally bypassed during Day 2 migration — every migrated consumer had pre-existing custom mutationFn/queryFn logic (rate-limit retry, multipart upload, shared mutation chain) that the hook abstraction couldn't accommodate without losing intent. Hooks remain available for NEW consumers; existing 14 consumers unwrap envelopes inline. The hook layer is intentionally thin (no jsdom test stack required) per its own docstring.

[2026-06-21] Chat mode picker UI: 4 sticky-per-thread pills (Chat → 'chat', Search → 'ground', Think harder → 'reason' with 'Pro' badge, Summarize → 'summarize'). Session token meter renders chars/4 estimate (not real usage events — stream API doesn't surface usage cleanly), with amber threshold at 10k and red at 25k. Meter resets on clearChat. The route forwards task to ai.generate, so the picker steers the router's per-task provider chain (e.g. 'reason' pins to gemini-pro per ADR-0044). The 'extract' task class is deliberately NOT exposed in the chat picker — it's a JSON-shape task that doesn't fit the streaming UI.

[2026-06-21] Sprint commits for ADR-0045: 94fb9e1 (ADR Proposed), 5c6758f (Day 1 helpers + hooks + chip), 21c422e (Day 2 Batch A 7 routes + consumers), 90d615c (Day 2 Batch B 6 routes + 4 consumers), 7590d6d (Day 3 chat panel mode picker + token meter), 105fd03 (Day 4 chat-route task-forwarding tests +7), Day 5 = ADR Accepted + handoff. Test baseline at sprint end: 880 passed | 5 skipped (was 873).
